art_direction: A graceful wide shot inside the same room: Wu Xie stands at the open doorway, speaking quietly and urgently to Pan Zi. Pan Zi rises from the stool by the wooden table, the blue-rimmed bowl of half-eaten noodles clearly still on the table and bamboo chopsticks set beside the bowl. Give the men a natural attentive gaze, no gestures of threat, no uniformed people. Warm indoor light and a cooler corridor beyond the door make the imminent journey felt.
visible_description: 吴邪在门口找潘子，潘子搁下筷子准备出门。
poster_text: 小三爷来了，潘子放下筷子便起身。
source_chapter: 《盗墓笔记8》大结局第七十四章（二）
adaptation_note: 小三爷到门口叫人、出发前回望和离开路上的画面为基于用户叙述的虚构改编；潘子是否预感归期为吴邪的猜测。
